ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: a clean colony
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: Filth is piling up inside the home area, and someone with standards has noticed.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: No more than {TARGET} pieces of filth left in the home area.

plain.li: There's blood in the hallway, mud in the dining room and something I won't name in the corner. Can we clean?
We live like animals. Animals keep their dens cleaner.
[afterraid] The raid's over. The mess isn't. Somebody fetch a broom.
[rain] Every pair of boots in this colony has brought half the yard inside.

warm.li: I'll help, of course. But could we all spend a day making this place clean again?

blunt.li: This place is filthy. I'm not eating in it again until somebody cleans.

cheerful.li: Cleaning day! Everyone grab a broom! It'll be fun! It won't be fun. But clean!

gloomy.li: Dirt everywhere. Fitting, really. Still, I'd like to not live in it.

cold.li: Filth spreads disease and lowers morale. It also offends me.

plain.li: Clean floors. I could weep. I won't, I'd make a mess.
I'll just stop looking at the floor, then.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: music in the colony
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: An artist or born entertainer wants an instrument: music for the evenings.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: The colony has {THING} or another instrument.

plain.li: We have walls, beds and guns. What we don't have is music. Build {THING}.
[evening] The evenings are so quiet you can hear the raiders thinking. Some music would help.
[winter] A long winter needs songs. Let me have {THING}.

warm.li: I'd play for everyone, every evening. Just give me {THING}.

blunt.li: If I have to listen to one more person whistle, I'll snap. Get me {THING}.

cheerful.li: Music! Dancing! Terrible singing! The colony needs it, and I need {THING}!

gloomy.li: Some sad songs would suit this place. I'd need {THING} for that.

cold.li: Music measurably improves morale. {THING} would be an efficient investment.

plain.li: Listen to that. Out here, of all places.

cheerful.li: First song's for everyone who built it! Second song's for me!

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: proper armor
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: A fighter going into every raid in ordinary clothes wants armor the colony can make.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: {PAWN_nameDef} wears something with real armor (at least {TARGET} sharp armor).

plain.li: I'm the one standing in front when they come. I'd like something between me and their bullets.
[trigger:raid] That arrow went straight through my shirt. My shirt was not consulted.
[lowtech] Leather, plate, anything. I'm tired of fighting in a tunic.

warm.li: I don't mind being the one who fights. I'd just like to come back from it.

blunt.li: Armor. For me. Before the next raid, not after my funeral.

cheerful.li: Picture me in shining armor! Now picture me surviving! Both good!

gloomy.li: One of these raids is going to kill me. Armor would make it a later one.

cold.li: My survival rate in combat would improve substantially with armor.

plain.li: Fits. Heavy. Perfect. Let them come.

blunt.li: Good. Now point me at the next idiot with a gun.

plain.li: I'll go out in my shirt again, then. Pray for me.
